vessels.title: Anchor Handling Tug Vessel
vessels.description: Specialized offshore vessel designed for towing, anchor handling, and supporting drilling operations in demanding marine environments.
info: Deploys, retrieves, and repositions anchors for offshore rigs and floating installations.
Provides powerful towing capabilities for offshore structures and marine equipment.
Accommodates up to 25 crew members for continuous offshore operations.

vessels.title: Self Elevating Unit
vessels.description: Jack-up platform capable of elevating above sea level, providing a stable working environment for offshore construction and maintenance.
info: Raises the platform above the water surface to ensure safe and stable operations.
Supports drilling, maintenance, and installation projects in shallow waters.
Designed to accommodate up to 60 personnel onboard.

vessels.title: Offshore Supply Vessel
vessels.description: Versatile vessel used to transport cargo, equipment, fuel, and supplies to offshore platforms and installations.
info: Delivers essential materials and equipment to offshore facilities.
Supports offshore operations through reliable transportation of fuel and fresh water.
Provides accommodation for up to 30 crew members.

vessels.title: Diving Support Vessel
vessels.description: Purpose-built vessel equipped to support underwater inspection, maintenance, repair, and construction activities.
info: Supports saturation and air diving missions in offshore environments.
Operates remotely operated vehicles for subsea inspection and intervention.
Accommodates up to 40 specialists and crew members.

vessels.title: Multicat
vessels.description: Compact multi-purpose workboat used for towing, dredging support, anchor handling, and marine construction projects.
info: Suitable for a wide range of offshore and coastal support tasks.
Assists dredging, cable laying, and marine infrastructure projects.
Operates efficiently with up to 12 crew members.

vessels.title: Pipe Layer
vessels.description: Heavy-duty offshore construction vessel dedicated to subsea pipeline installation for oil, gas, and renewable energy projects.
info: Installs subsea pipelines with high precision in offshore environments.
Handles large construction modules and offshore infrastructure components.
Provides accommodation for up to 150 personnel.
